name: AprilX
short: Ollama-backed roleplay chat cog with multi-provider fallback.
description: Separate chat cog using a locally hosted Ollama model. Commands under `aprilx`. Also supports DeepSeek, OpenAI, and Anthropic as provider overrides. No TTS, no images, no Loki — pure chat.
author: Rezyyn
install_msg: Load with `[p]load april_x`. Configure Ollama URL and model with `[p]aprilxcfg ollamaurl` and `[p]aprilxcfg ollamamodel`. Test connectivity with `[p]aprilxcfg ollamatest`.
